errors.says: Method: 'stage j adds the bank X into Y along coordinate j (forward invocation), then subtracts Y from X, then adds X to Y again'. Read literally, every stage performs a forward addition, and all three operations happen within stage j.
errors.paper: Stage 1 is a forward invocation X->Y, stage 2 is the inverse schedule Y->X (X <- X - Y), and stage 3 is a forward invocation X->Y; each stage acts along its own coordinate. S1.1.2 states this correctly, so the issue is ambiguous wording in the method line only.

errors.says: Each prefix-slot round halves a bit individually 'in O(Tp) per round', and with at most b+1 <= K rounds 'these rounds cost O(TpdK) in total'.
errors.paper: Within a prefix-slot round, each participating bit is processed individually at O(Tp) for its moves and scans. A round therefore costs O(Tpd), which gives the total O(TpdK); a per-round cost of O(Tp) would give O(TpK), inconsistent with the stated total.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from beginning to end. The bit and complex networks (S1.1-S1.4) give s<Wm and s/W<m^tau, which feed the interchange recurrence (S1.5) and the butterfly-layer recurrence (S1.6). These lead to synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S2), resampling with the permutations left in the identity plus chirp cancellation (S3), parameters and primes (S4), the CRT, twist, algorithm and exact recovery (S5), and the cost table with margin 2kappa (S6). The chain does not break anywhere. It thins out only where the elementary stream and controlled-shift lemmas are used without being stated, and in a per-round cost slip in S2.3d that does not affect the total.

steps.note: h=100, banks X_a,Y_a indexed by T^3, N = binom(h,3)^3 and m = h^3 with exact values, the fixed network sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a), and every scratch wire restored.

Common frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, route operator eps_w D_sink D_source^{-1}, and the explicit point that intermediate frames are free to make edges cheap.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{tensor 3} (dimension m), comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h (P tensor F).
P_V - P_U has rank dim V - dim U, so an edge costs its label dimension change; the N source edges are rank-one exceptions (2P_{U_a}).
Sum of |Delta dim| = Wm - 2N + 2L with L = Ich, and s_b = (Wm - 2N + 2L_b) + N = W_b m - N + 2L_b.
L/N = 100/539 or 101/539 < 1/2, so the bit deficit N - 2L_b > 0 (and 2N - 2L_c > 0 for the complex network), giving s < Wm.
Endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp} - (-P_{U_a}) = I_m on X_a, with zero and identity elsewhere, so the bit network applies H <- H + D on every role, scratch rows included.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V); the recursive calls of a node therefore total s.
Children of volume V/W, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1} + O(1), s/W < m^tau with tau = 1-2^{-50} from eta > 20*2^{-50} and log m < 20, and F_k = O(e^tau) by the geometric sum.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs all nine steps of the central saving with their defining content and in their roles. It covers the fixed h=100 exchange network, frames, nested labels with only central 3->4 losses, rank equal to dimension change with the N rank-one source exceptions, the budget W_b m - N + 2L_b, the strict deficit from L/N = 100/539, the endpoint identity giving H <- H + D, edges as exactly rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau = 1-2^{-50}.
